title: Housing Funds Support Austin Seniors & Families
summary:
*   **Major Boost for Garden Terrace Apartments:** Approved an extra $500,000, bringing the total loan to nearly $1.8 million, to help develop the Garden Terrace Apartments.
*   **Affordable Homes for Seniors at Oak Springs:** Facilitated 56 new affordable rental units for low-income elderly families at Oak Springs Villas with a long-term $1/year lease and a $466,715 development loan.
*   **Expanded Senior Living at Rosewood I:** Authorized an $800,000 loan to create 54 affordable rental units for low-income elderly families at the Rosewood I Senior Housing Community.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING MINUTES
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 6, 2003
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened on
Thursday, February 6, 2003, in the Board Room at the Lower Colorado River Authority Hancock
Building, 3700 Lake Austin Boulevard, Austin, Texas. The following were the AHFC items
considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors.
President Garcia called the meeting to order at 3:00 p.m.
AHFC-1. 
Approval of minutes for Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
January 9, 2003.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
January 9,2003 were approved on Board Member Alvarez* motion, Board Member
XVynn's second on a 6-0 vote. President Garcia was off the dais.
AHFC-5. 
Approve the appointment of Sedora Jefferson as General Counsel, Paul Hilgers as
Treasurer, Shirley A. Brown as Secretary and Yvonne Spence as Assistant Secretary of
the Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation for terms expiring
June 15,2003.
The motion authorizing the appointment of the General Counsel, Treasurer,
Secretary and Assistant Secretary was approved on Board Member Thomas' motion,
Board Member Dunkerley's second on a 6-0 vote. President Garcia was off the dais.
AHFC-2. 
Authorize an amendment to the Rental Housing Development Assistance Program Loan
Agreement with the Garden Terrace Housing Corporation by increasing the loan amount
by $500,000 for a total loan amount not to exceed $1,775,750 for the development of the
Garden Terrace Apartments at 1015 West William Cannon Drive.
Funding: $500,000 is available in the Rental Housing Development Assistance program,
fiscal year 2002-03 Austin Housing Finance Corporation budget. It is anticipated that
the loan will be funded with Community Development Block Grant funds.
The motion authorizing an amendment was approved on Board Member
Dunkerley's motion, Board Member Wynn's second on a 6-0 vote. 
President
Garcia was off the dais.
